Bill.BriefDescription: Updating the state environmental policy act checklist.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to updating the state environmental policy actchecklist; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of ecology must, byDecember 31, 2012, amend WAC 197-11-960, as it existed on the effectivedate of this section, to add the following to the checklist: (a) Potential downstream or down-gradient impacts to waters orwaterways, including, but not limited to, flooding, erosion,sedimentation, habitat loss or impacts, and increased burdens ondownstream jurisdictions from a project or proposal; (b) Potential adverse impacts to the ability of local transitagencies to meet relevant transit service standards and whethermitigation measures may alleviate or restore transit service to meetthese standards; and (c) Potential adverse impacts to the ability of school districts tomeet capacity standards or plans developed by school districts forkindergarten through grade twelve public schools, and whethermitigation measures may alleviate or restore transit service to meet p. 1 HB 2710these standards. (2) This section expires July 31, 2013.
